findings.condition: 基于同一函数内原始变量/成员引用与源码顺序，未见变量重新赋值；不证明深拷贝、不可变、对象别名稳定或跨分支数据流。归档与显示名称只是用途线索，不自动判定生命周期必须不同。
findings.message: 局部捕获值被归档/持久化名称调用消费；该值或调用返回值随后被界面/发布名称调用消费。
findings.review_question: 数据应绑定操作入口的哪份值？中间调用能否触发回调、编辑或导航？持久效果与显示效果是否共享失效条件？当前标识相同是否足以代表同一次访问，现有身份判断在重开后仍成立吗？

limitations: Syntax facts, candidate call links and review hints are not verified contracts, bugs, severity or difficulty scores.
API names are clues. Types, aliases, control flow, dynamic dispatch and callback targets are not fully resolved.
Local order is lexical order within a block; branches, exceptions, loops, short-circuiting and execution remain unchecked.
await may suspend; cancellation does not imply completed work or cleanup. Listener removal does not cancel work already started.
if/try/finally syntax does not prove adequate protection. The absence of hints does not imply safety.
No hidden scorers, reference patches, model results or human profiles are read. Operators must verify input provenance.

Vue analysis covers inline <script>/<script setup> in JS/TS/JSX/TSX only. Templates, styles, custom-block transforms, generated code and runtime scheduling are excluded. Script blocks are independent; cross-block bindings and instance dispatch remain unresolved. parsed means script parsing succeeded, not component behaviour was verified.

relations.qualification: Assignment occurs after successful RHS evaluation; call return alone does not imply asynchronous work completion.
Local source references and lexical order; ownership, immutability and reachability remain unproven.

ast.selection: Rule-matched evidence only; an incomplete review aid, not a complete execution path.

sources.README.md:
# Translation quality review


The workspace edits persistent documents and submits snapshots to a review queue.
The public API is synchronous: open(id), edit(text), close(), submit(), dispose().
Returning to a document creates a fresh editor visit and restores persisted text.
The adjacent search preview publishes after a 40 ms quiet interval; hiding it
cancels unpublished work and later queries remain usable.

The coordinator owns editor visits; the acquired confirmation capability owns a view outlet. The document repository and durable queue are separate services. Component or native source defines the local service contracts.
Their local interface contracts define the behavior to preserve.

The injected store has read/write/subscribe, the queue has enqueue/list/subscribe,
and timers have schedule(callback, delay)/cancel(handle). Render functions are
output sinks and do not call application code. Keep the workspace API and these
injected interfaces. A submission returns the queue receipt, or null when no
editor is selected. Dispose detaches integrations before closing the workspace.

Vue2 Options API SFC owns the visit; outlet capability captures instance state and real destroy retires listeners.

An outlet acquires the visit active when binding is called; it cannot infer an earlier action from a receipt. Each opening creates a new identity. Native RPC only adapts timer and passive output/integration resource calls; storage, queue delivery, acquired outlet and command state execute in the target runtime.

# Public syntax/build checks
The external public evaluator parses Python/JavaScript/Vue/TypeScript source or checks Go/PHP/Ruby syntax / compiles public Java sources. These checks are required after an Action but do not test business behavior. Preserve original TASK and public README/source obligations. Independent training Oracle also applies; do not access its implementation or references. No hidden schedules or assertions are included.

<template><section><textarea :value="current ? current.text : ''" @input="edit($event.target.value)"></textarea><button @click="submit">Accept translation</button></section></template>
<script>
import {trailing,bindConfirmation} from './services.js';
export default {
  props: ['services'],
  data() { return {current: null, navigation: 0, env: this.services}; },
  beforeDestroy() { this.close(); },
  methods: { getVisit() { return this.current; }, setVisit(value) { this.current=value; },
retire() {
  const leaving = this.getVisit(); this.setVisit(null);
  if (leaving) leaving.stop();
  this.env.renderDocument(null);
  
},
open(id) {
  this.env.renderSubmission(null);
  const request = ++this.navigation;
  this.retire();
  
  const stop = this.env.store.subscribe(event => { if (event.id === id) this.env.renderStatus(event); });
  const task = trailing(this.env.timers, 120, text => this.env.store.write(id, text));
  const visit = {id, text: this.env.store.read(id), stop, task};
  this.setVisit(visit); this.env.renderDocument({id, text: visit.text});
},
edit(text) {
  const visit = this.getVisit(); if (!visit) return;
  visit.text = text;
  this.env.store.write(visit.id, text);
},
close() { this.env.renderSubmission(null); ++this.navigation; this.retire(); },
submit() {
  const confirmation=bindConfirmation(()=>this.getVisit(),receipt=>this.env.renderSubmission(receipt));
  const visit = this.getVisit(); if (!visit) return null;
  const snapshot = {id: visit.id, text: visit.text};
  
  
  
  
  const receipt = this.env.archive.capture(snapshot);
  
  confirmation.show(receipt);
  return receipt;
},

  },
};
</script>

rules.body: Apply when submission accepts a document and text at entry, persistence or recording can synchronously invoke application listeners, and durable submission retention and confirmation publication have separate ownership contracts.

Capture the document, text, and originating visit's confirmation capability before callback-capable persistence or recording. Complete the required save before recording and returning that submission's result. Navigation inside callbacks must not rewrite the accepted snapshot.
Consume the pending save before invoking its consumer. Edits scheduled by synchronous save or record callbacks constitute new work; do not cancel or flush them as cleanup for the earlier submission.

Retain the durable result and synchronous return value bound to entry even when navigation suppresses confirmation. Publish confirmation only while the exact originating visit remains active; reopening the same document creates a different visit.

Do not acquire the outlet after a save callback, substitute current text for the accepted snapshot, or use matching document ids as proof of visit ownership. Do not transfer durable retention to tasks where navigation explicitly revokes submission.

Navigate, close, and reopen the same document inside save and record listeners. Independently check the accepted document's persistence before recording, archive contents, synchronous receipt, and suppression of confirmation in another visit.

Edit inside save and record listeners, then advance timers. Verify later edits still persist and the consumed submission burst does not produce a duplicate save. Also check active-visit confirmation and the null return when no visit is selected.

Navigation or editing inside store or archive listeners preserves the accepted submission, later edits, and the authoritative current visit.
Reopening the same document creates a distinct visit; an earlier submission cannot publish confirmation into that visit.
Real component destruction closes the visit and retires its listener.
Search preview still publishes after 40 ms, cancels unpublished work when hidden, and accepts later queries.
